title: A Value to Fall Back On

args: const parse = withFallback(JSON.parse, null); return [parse("[1, 2]"), parse("oops")];
const first = withFallback((list) => list[0].name, "nobody"); return [first([{ name: "Ada" }]), first([])];
const add = withFallback((a, b, c) => a + b + c, 0); return add(1, 2, 3);
let calls = 0; const f = withFallback(() => { calls += 1; throw new Error("no"); }, -1); return [f(), f(), calls];
const f = withFallback(() => undefined, "fallback"); return f() === undefined;
